goal: Allow generateblock to create blocks with multiple coinbase outputs and custom payout amounts
Enable mining directly from the mempool on regtest without manual block construction
Simplifies simulating complex mining pool payout schemes like Ocean and Braidpool for developers
agreement: Substantive support for enabling testing of multi-recipient coinbase protocols (supertestnet)
Suggested requiring at least one output address instead of allowing an empty list (achow101)
Suggested splitting the optional transactions argument into a preparatory PR (maflcko)
Suggested wording refinements for the release notes (fanquake)

categories.name: mining
why: P3 because regtest mining tooling only benefits developers testing specialized pool payout schemes
Removes the need to manually craft raw blocks when simulating protocols like Ocean or Braidpool

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it expands generateblock to address an interface gap requested by downstream testers
Eliminates custom external scripting previously needed to generate blocks with multi-output coinbases
